en: Well, look at you! I'm Sidney of the Elite Four. You came all this way, so I like you already.
But liking you won't stop me. I play dirty, and I play to win. Can you keep up with that?
No more talking. Let's have a battle we'll both remember!
Ha! That's it, I'm beaten. And I don't even mind. That was a battle and a half!
Go on through. The rest of the Elite Four won't go easy on you. Show them what you showed me!
Don't look back now. The next room is waiting for you. Go and win it!
